notes.title: We are back
notes.notes:
We hope everyone had a wonderful holiday season! Production for Doors More Doors was briefly paused to allow our team to enjoy a well-deserved Christmas break. Now that the new year is upon us, we’re excited to announce that development is officially back in full swing!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274040/Doors_More_Doors/

notes.title: NOW ON STEAM
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to share that my upcoming game, Doors More Doors, is now available for wishlisting on Steam. The game will take you on a psychological adventure through an underground facility filled with countless doors, where your main objective is to escape while dealing with various obstacles and hostile entities.

You can support the project by adding it to your Steam wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3274040/Doors_More_Doors/

Additionally, feel free to join our growing community on Discord to stay updated on development, share your thoughts, and get sneak peeks at what's to come:
https://discord.gg/39cwpGNgnN

Your support means a lot as we continue to work on making this game the best experience possible.
